work_completed.description: Validated and corrected amino acid frequencies to match UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot data
work_completed.rationale: Original frequencies contained inaccuracies that compromised biological realism of negative sampling
work_completed.verification: Cross-referenced with multiple authoritative sources including Klecker et al., McCaldon & Argos, and UniProtKB compositional analysis

work_completed.description: Enhanced Proline context-dependent behavior with position-specific preferences

caveats: Context prediction is simplified - real structural context would require secondary structure prediction tools

work_completed.rationale: Uniform 15% mutation rate ignores natural conservation patterns found in real proteins

caveats: Full conservation analysis requires multiple sequence alignments not available in this context
